reminder.notes:
Search, bulk actions, quiet hours, month view, stats, quick add, and a home-screen widget

A large feature release. Reminders can now be searched, selected in bulk, seen
as a month, summarised as stats, added by typing one plain sentence, mirrored
into Google Calendar, and read from a home-screen widget. Settings also gained
a reliability check that tells you, plainly, whether this phone can actually
ring your reminders.

### Features

- Search across every reminder by title, note, or category, covering scheduled,
  disabled, and done ones. Reached from the magnifier on Today and Upcoming.
- Bulk select: long-press a reminder and choose Select, then delete, disable or
  enable, or move the whole selection to another category in one pass.
- Quiet hours: a nightly window in which Normal and Medium reminders wait until
  the window ends instead of ringing. Urgent reminders always ring through, and
  a snooze you set yourself is never moved.
- Month view inside Upcoming: a grid of when reminders actually fire, with the
  chosen day's list underneath.
- Stats: completion rate, a completed/dismissed/snoozed breakdown, per-category
  rates, and a day streak, over the last 7 days, 30 days, or all time.
- Quick add: type "gym tomorrow 7am", "pay rent every month", or "call mum in
  2 hours" and the editor opens pre-filled. It previews what it understood
  first, and never saves without you confirming.
- Reliability check in Settings: exact alarms, notifications, full-screen alarm,
  battery restrictions, manufacturer autostart, and how many alarms are really
  armed, each with a fix shortcut. Opening it also re-arms anything missing.
- Home-screen widget showing the next reminders, with a one-tap add button.
- Show reminders in Google Calendar, off by default. It writes into a calendar
  already on the phone, which your Google account then syncs, so no new sign-in
  or permission grant to Google is involved. Turning it off removes every event
  it created.

### Bug fixes

No user-facing bug fixes in this release. Reminder delivery, sync, and the alarm
screen are unchanged apart from quiet hours, which only moves a non-urgent fire
time forward and is skipped entirely for Urgent reminders.

ai-scanner.notes:
AI Scanner 1.4.1 — Background update checks, and no more double-downloading updates

### Features
- AI Scanner now checks for updates periodically in the background (about every 6 hours) and posts a notification when one is found, in addition to the existing manual "Check for Updates" in Settings. Tapping the notification opens the app; the download and install still happen from the Settings sheet.

### Bug fixes
- The update downloader now persists its in-flight DownloadManager id and re-attaches to a still-running download instead of deleting the partial file and starting over — fixes re-downloading the same update from zero after backgrounding or reopening the app mid-update.
- The update sheet now re-syncs its progress on resume instead of occasionally showing a frozen progress bar.

mirrordrive.notes:
Show the app version and PNSJY branding in Settings

Settings now ends with the current app version and the PNSJY store branding, so every
PNSJY app presents the same footer.

### Features

- The Settings screen now shows the installed app version and a PNSJY brand footer as its
  last two items, consistent across all PNSJY apps.

### Bug fixes

No user-facing bug fixes in this release.
